subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Chancing Faith
email_body:
Hi Empi,

I came across your work while looking at Ghanaian romance authors, and the fact that Most Eligible Bachelor was named Book of the Year at the 2017 Ufere Awards, and that Chancing Faith won third prize in the Ayi Kwei Armah Novel category of the 2018 Ghana Association of Writers Literary Awards, stood out to me.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Chancing Faith is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, from concept to finished files. It is entirely optional and can sit alongside the feature or be considered on its own, whichever suits you better.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Chancing Faith best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
